$schema_note: Local reference data only. Different joins/fits need different clearances - do not use a single universal tolerance.

seam_gap_mm.use_case: Tight visible seams between two aligned parts that should read as nearly flush.

letter_pocket_clearance_mm.use_case: Pocket for an inset/raised letter or badge that should sit snugly but still fit without forcing.

connector_clearance_mm.use_case: Peg/socket or dowel-style connectors joining two printed parts.

decorative_inlay_clearance_mm.use_case: Decorative inlay pieces (e.g. contrasting color inlay) that should sit snugly with minimal gap.

sliding_fit_clearance_mm.use_case: Parts intended to slide or be removable after printing, e.g. a drawer or sliding cover.

notes: Do not default to 0.10mm as a universal fit tolerance - it is only appropriate for tight seam gaps.
Actual required clearance also depends on printer calibration, material, and orientation; treat these as starting points for human review, not guarantees.
